name: Columbus Tower (Sentinel Building)
note: From scratch: copper-green 1907 flatiron, 916 Kearny at Columbus. The prow is a drum least-squares fitted to the footprint's own arc (r derived, not typed); banded round windows up it, SF bay windows on both street flanks, stucco party wall, domed cupola and gilt finial on the drum. Commons photographs way-288485994-02/-03 (geotagged 33/34 m).
